observation.summary: The call reached the test-line AI, but the discharge-availability roleplay did not complete. The agent declined to continue after saying it could not play Dana, and the bot did not finish the required opening setup or collect the planned availability answers.
evidence: The call connected and lasted about 71 seconds.
The test-line AI initially engaged with the roleplay request, then said it could not pretend to be Dana.
No payer, bed, wound VAC, IV antibiotic, coordinator, or referral contact answers were collected.
